s.how: Boil 3 eggs and mash with mayo and cress. Make sandwiches of egg, cucumber with 100g cream cheese, and 100g ham with Dijon, using 12 slices white bread. Cut off the crusts and cut into exact little squares. Stand them up in rows.

s.note: nothing with nuts in this house
s.how: Mix 80g each of sunflower, pumpkin and sesame seeds with 2 tbsp chia, 250ml water and salt and stand 15 minutes. Spread thin on a lined tray and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then break up. Blitz 250g cooked beetroot with 150g Greek yoghurt for the dip.

m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 250g mushrooms and 2 sliced leeks. Add 150ml white wine and 200ml cream and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.

w.note: Charlie can't have nuts, so this one has none
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 200g sugar, fold in the chocolate and 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 35 minutes. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. Check every label for nuts first.

d.note: Annie pours a glass at the end of the night
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of Shiraz half an hour before dinner. Serve just under room temperature, about 150ml a glass. Put a bottle of mineral water on the table too.
